## In the 1380s [Record]

A Nemunas island near Lampėdžiai where the Order built a fort in autumn 1391; its guests were seized and the fort destroyed in summer 1392 ([event](../events/ev_ritterswerder_1392.qmd)).

## Sensory sketch
<!-- Smell, sound, light, weather by season. -->

## In the saga

The wooden fort smells of resin and Order ale; Vytautas's name hangs over its gate: "dar viena dovana, kuri buvo paskola".
